title: WHEN THE MOON RISES, WE SHARE A MESSAGE
editorialDisclaimer: Original fictional editorial adaptation created inside the MoonWitness XV Creative Lab. This episode is NOT a recovered historical transcript, does NOT depict real users or sacred figures, and preserves incomplete observations without forcing final interpretation.
centralTheme: A message is worth preserving even when not every part is known.

panels.characterPosition: skyline establishing wide before cutting to Kuro's rooftop perch
panels.composition: Wide 16:9 nocturnal Moon City skyline framed by tangled rooftop utility wires beneath a luminous halftone crescent moon with generous upper sky negative space.
panels.visualAction: Silver crescent moon presides over neon-accented midnight skyscrapers and suspended cables as a faint carrier frequency begins to stir.
panels.actingIntent: Establish quiet nocturnal tension before the first radio spark interrupts the silence.
panels.speaker: NARRATOR
panels.dialogue: No carrier wave on the upper band yet—only rooftop wind and iron cables.
panels.caption: 01 · MOON CITY ROOFTOP · ERA THRESHOLD: CAPTURE
panels.narrativePurpose: Anchors MoonWitness II World Rule 01: The Moon is the symbolic anchor of the Witness layer.
panels.reducedMotionNote: Displays static Moon City nocturnal establishing wide shot with zero camera drift.

panels.characterPosition: viewer-right medium shot leaning on moonlit rooftop rail
panels.composition: Asymmetric medium shot isolating Kuro Signal's silhouette and upright headset antenna against the open dark sky so the sudden cyan spark pops unmistakably.
panels.visualAction: Kuro leans lazily on the railing until an electric cyan-yellow pulse cracks at the headset antenna, snapping Kuro into an alert whip reaction with concentric radio rings.
panels.actingIntent: Sharp cartoon anticipation dip followed by electric surprise snap.
panels.speaker: KURO SIGNAL
panels.dialogue: Wait—sub-band four just keyed open! Short pulse, low power!
panels.caption: 02 · SIGNAL INTERCEPT · BEAT ANIM-A (FRAMES 01–03)
panels.narrativePurpose: Initiates the CAPTURE → CONNECT sequence with an unexpected low-power transmission.
panels.reducedMotionNote: Holds whip reaction keyframe (frame-03.webp) without chromatic flash or camera shake.

panels.characterPosition: Kuro three-quarter medium close-up with corner manga inset of receiver screen
panels.composition: Split-panel comic layout pairing Kuro's curious leaning reaction with an angled corner macro inset of the yellow-taped portable receiver displaying three waveform peaks and two dark dropouts.
panels.visualAction: Kuro lifts the flickering portable receiver into view, leans forward squinting intently, then breaks into a star-eyed grin of courier resolve.
panels.actingIntent: Shift from startle into concentrated curiosity and restless urgency.
panels.speaker: KURO SIGNAL
panels.dialogue: Three clean carrier bars... and two dead drop-outs. If I wait for a repeat, the drift will swallow it.
panels.caption: 03 · PARTIAL WAVEFORM LOCK · BEAT ANIM-A (FRAMES 04–06)
panels.narrativePurpose: Establishes upfront that the incoming message arrives fragmented.
panels.reducedMotionNote: Holds curious resolve hero frame (frame-06.webp) alongside static receiver close-up inset.

panels.characterPosition: left-to-right parkour rooftop trajectory ending at archive loft hatch
panels.composition: Seven-keyframe Spider-Verse action sequence following Kuro from low rooftop coil through diagonal launch, mid-air moonlit alley vault, chromatic smear dash, heel-plant spark skid, squash landing, and excited door knock.
panels.visualAction: Kuro sprints, vaults the neon alley chasm under the crescent moon, blurs into a magenta-cyan smear dash across cables, and skids to an eager knock at Vesper's archive door.
panels.actingIntent: Full cartoon squash-and-stretch agility expressing Kuro's kinetic impatience.
panels.speaker: KURO SIGNAL
panels.dialogue: Hold the press, Vesper! Carrying a live fragment straight off the north array!
panels.caption: 04 · COURIER TRANSIT · BEAT ANIM-B (FRAMES 01–07)
panels.narrativePurpose: Embodies MoonWitness II Breath Electric energy—carrying raw observation to the Witness Archive.
panels.reducedMotionNote: Displays apex rooftop vault keyframe (frame-03.webp) cleanly without speed strobing or camera shake.

panels.characterPosition: Kuro foreground left shoulder; Vesper Ink waist-up center-right behind workbench
panels.composition: Over-the-shoulder interior shot past Kuro's magenta-lined hood onto Vesper Ink's warm yellow lamp-lit zine workbench beside the cyan CRT oscilloscope.
panels.visualAction: Kuro slides the portable receiver and paper waveform printout onto the workbench; Vesper calmly lifts the strip with her brass stylus poised.
panels.actingIntent: Contrast Kuro's breathless rush with Vesper's unhurried archival composure (strict waist-up canon).
panels.speaker: KURO SIGNAL
panels.dialogue: Fresh off the relay! Listen to the cadence—we can patch the missing bars and run the headline tonight!
panels.caption: 05 · ARCHIVE WORKBENCH HANDOFF · BEAT ANIM-C (FRAMES 01–02)
panels.narrativePurpose: Moves the transmission from field interception into disciplined archival review.
panels.reducedMotionNote: Displays static over-the-shoulder workbench reception frame (frame-01.webp).

panels.characterPosition: Vesper Ink waist-up center frame holding printed waveform strip
panels.composition: Balanced medium-close portrait of Vesper Ink waist-up between the cyan oscilloscope and warm yellow desk lamp; brass violet/cyan goggles glint above calm analytical eyes.
panels.visualAction: Vesper holds the printout strip level between steady hands, scanning each bar and pausing sharply where the ink line drops out.
panels.actingIntent: Quiet, economical editorial scrutiny without theatrical exaggeration.
panels.speaker: VESPER INK
panels.dialogue: Carrier header is intact. Timestamp mark is clean. Let's see what actually crossed the wire.
panels.caption: 06 · ARCHIVIST INSPECTION · BEAT ANIM-C (FRAME 03)
panels.narrativePurpose: Demonstrates careful source examination before making any narrative claim.
panels.reducedMotionNote: Holds Vesper Ink waist-up analytical inspection close-up (frame-03.webp).

panels.characterPosition: no character on screen; top-down macro view of paper transmission slip
panels.composition: Stark top-down tabletop macro on a dark halftone cutting mat: three bright cyan/yellow decoded waveform tracks interrupted by two torn-tape-framed empty dashed void slots.
panels.visualAction: Pinned by a yellow binder clip and hot-magenta gaffer tape, the paper slip exposes two unmistakably blank unresolved signal voids.
panels.actingIntent: Let the physical evidence speak directly—missing data cannot be cosmetically patched.
panels.speaker: VESPER INK
panels.dialogue: Three verified clauses. Two unrecovered voids in the middle of the line.
panels.caption: 07 · INCOMPLETE ARTIFACT · MACRO EVIDENCE VIEW
panels.narrativePurpose: Visualizes MoonWitness II World Rule 03: Mystery, unknown, and unresolved states are valid parts of the universe.
panels.reducedMotionNote: Static macro display of fragment-slip-incomplete.webp with zero motion.

panels.characterPosition: Kuro gesturing eagerly on viewer-left; Vesper composed on viewer-right raising calm halt hand
panels.composition: Asymmetric two-character confrontation across the archive desk pitting Kuro's animated full-hand persuasion against Vesper's unruffled single raised palm and brass stylus.
panels.visualAction: Kuro urges filling in the blank bridge immediately to publish tonight; Vesper remains completely rooted and calmly lifts one open palm to pause the rush.
panels.actingIntent: Peak character contrast: energetic impatience vs measured epistemic restraint.
panels.speaker: KURO SIGNAL
panels.dialogue: We can infer the bridge from last week's frequency! Close the gap and publish the whole story!
panels.caption: 08 · TEMPTATION TO INFER · BEAT ANIM-C (FRAME 04)
panels.narrativePurpose: Dramatizes the ethical boundary between convenient speculation and honest witnessing.
panels.reducedMotionNote: Displays static two-shot contrast frame (frame-04.webp) with zero impact shake.

panels.characterPosition: Vesper waist-up center-right annotating blotter; Kuro listening attentively on viewer-left
panels.composition: Warm balanced studio framing; Vesper marks the two dashed voids with her brass stylus then frames the sheet calmly as Kuro leans back, absorbing the principle.
panels.visualAction: Vesper touches her stylus beside the blank intervals with a gentle knowing smirk and rests both hands framing the intact incomplete sheet.
panels.actingIntent: Quiet authority without scolding; Kuro settles from impatience into respect.
panels.speaker: VESPER INK
panels.dialogue: A witness records what arrived, Kuro—not what we wish filled the silence. The gap stays marked as unknown.
panels.caption: 09 · WITNESS RULE · BEAT ANIM-C (FRAMES 05–06)
panels.narrativePurpose: Enacts MoonWitness II World Rule 02: A witness records an observation without forcing a final interpretation.

panels.characterPosition: Kuro standing calmly viewer-left; Vesper waist-up sealing kraft folio viewer-right
panels.composition: Harmonious two-character workbench staging paired with a tactile corner macro inset of the kraft archival folio sealed with two yellow binder clips and a magenta tape X.
panels.visualAction: Vesper aligns the partial sheet inside the kraft sleeve and clips it neatly with signal-yellow binder clips and magenta tape while Kuro watches in quiet agreement.
panels.actingIntent: Warm collaborative care—courier and archivist preserve an honest incomplete record together.
panels.speaker: KURO SIGNAL
panels.dialogue: Verified bars logged. Unresolved gaps bracketed. Ready for the night relay.
panels.caption: 10 · SEALED WITH GAPS INTACT · BEAT ANIM-D (FRAMES 01–02)
panels.narrativePurpose: Completes PRESERVE → PROMOTE—carrying forward only what is honestly evidenced.
panels.reducedMotionNote: Displays sealed preservation two-shot (frame-02.webp) with static folio detail inset.

panels.characterPosition: exterior rooftop parabolic dish center-left against moonlit skyline
panels.composition: Poetic nocturnal exterior framing the archive rooftop parabolic dish as its relay pilot LED warms and emits one delicate concentric silver-cyan pulse toward answering golden windows.
panels.visualAction: The rooftop relay wakes with a tiny amber-cyan indicator and sends one gentle luminous signal wave across the midnight rooftops.
panels.actingIntent: Restrained poetic closure—quiet responsible broadcast, never a loud power-up explosion.
panels.speaker: VESPER INK
panels.dialogue: When the moon rises, we share the message—exact where it holds, open where it breaks.
panels.caption: 11 · NIGHT RELAY TRANSMISSION · BEAT ANIM-D (FRAMES 03–04)
panels.narrativePurpose: Shares the responsibly archived signal across Moon City.
panels.reducedMotionNote: Displays static quiet concentric pulse frame (frame-04.webp) with zero glow pulse animation.

panels.characterPosition: two tiny calm silhouettes in amber loft window transitioning to wide Moon City horizon
panels.composition: Expansive nocturnal wide ending shot with generous dark-sky negative space; giant silver-cream halftone crescent moon presides serenely above layered towers and one steady cyan relay beacon.
panels.visualAction: The quiet pulse dissolves past the warm-lit archive window into night mist, settling on Moon City beneath the watching crescent moon.
panels.actingIntent: Serene lasting resonance: the moon witnesses and the incomplete message endures.
panels.speaker: NARRATOR
panels.dialogue: The record is kept. The silence between the bars remains free to speak when its time arrives.
panels.caption: 12 · WHEN THE MOON RISES, WE SHARE A MESSAGE · END OF EP-LAB-01
